sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000102-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Maple Grove Regional Hospital 102 on February 3, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 3.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 65%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
